title: Herms for Hermes Agent
short_description: Independent client for your own Hermes Agent: chat, approvals, schedules, voice.
full_description:
Your Hermes Agent, connected to the gateway you run.

Herms is a native client for your own configured Hermes Agent gateway. Read streaming replies, send files, review sensitive-action approvals and manage agent work from your phone.

CHAT AND FILES
Keep conversations, formatted replies, code and attachments together. Stream replies, steer or stop a run, and inspect activity and usage.

APPROVALS AND CONTROL
Review sensitive requests before approving them with Android device authentication. Access cron schedules, agent sessions, projects and optional gateway integrations supported by your server.

VOICE AND WAKE
Dictate messages, use Talk, listen to spoken replies and optionally enable on-device Hey Jarvis wake-word detection. Speech recognition and TTS may use your system or gateway providers. Optional Wake alarms can use answers, photos or step events as proof.

YOUR GATEWAY
Requires Android 12 or later and a reachable, configured Hermes gateway with the compatible mobile plugin. The publisher does not host your chats or provide AI model credits. Your gateway's model/API providers may charge separately. Features depend on gateway configuration, connectivity and Android permissions.

The Play edition does not include autonomous Android Accessibility phone control or APK installation. Those are separate sideload-edition capabilities.

No automatic publisher analytics or crash-reporting program. Messages, files and enabled voice/proof features can leave your phone for your chosen gateway and its providers. Optional Google push/scanning and system speech services have their own data flows. See the privacy policy before pairing.

Herms is an independent client. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Nous Research, the developers of Hermes Agent.
